title: Felipehub SUPER OP
features: Head hitbox, aimbot,esp y jogadores teleporta para mim
script:
-- ==============================
-- SCRIPT 1 - HEAD HITBOX
-- ==============================
loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-Head-Hitbox-Expander-61730"))()

-- ==============================
-- SCRIPT 2 - ESP / AIMBOT
-- ==============================
loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://pastebin.com/raw/jCiJYHQn"))()
loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-Aimbot-y-esp-team-check-Universal-53607"))()

-- ==============================
-- SERVIÇOS
-- ==============================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

repeat task.wait() until LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")

-- ==============================
-- TP players for me (ALL)
-- ==============================
local enabled = false
local originalCollision = {}

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer.PlayerGui

local Button = Instance.new("TextButton")
Button.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 50)
Button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.5, -25)
Button.Text = "TP VISUAL: OFF"
Button.TextSize = 16
Button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 0, 0)
Button.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
Button.Parent = ScreenGui
Button.Active = true

-- BOTÃO ARRASTÁVEL
local dragging, dragStart, startPos = false

local function updateDrag(input)
	local delta = input.Position - dragStart
	Button.Position = UDim2.new(
		startPos.X.Scale,
		startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
		startPos.Y.Scale,
		startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
	)
end

Button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
	or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = Button.Position

		input.Changed:Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
				dragging = false
			end
		end)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if dragging and (
		input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
	) then
		updateDrag(input)
	end
end)

-- SEM COLISÃO
local function setNoCollision(character, state)
	for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			if originalCollision[part] == nil then
				originalCollision[part] = part.CanCollide
			end
			part.CanCollide = not state
			part.Massless = state
		end
	end
end

-- TOGGLE
Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	enabled = not enabled

	if enabled then
		Button.Text = "TP VISUAL: ON"
		Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 0)
	else
		Button.Text = "TP VISUAL: OFF"
		Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 0, 0)

		for part, canCollide in pairs(originalCollision) do
			if part and part.Parent then
				part.CanCollide = canCollide
				part.Massless = false
			end
		end
		originalCollision = {}
	end
end)

-- LOOP TP
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if not enabled then return end

	local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
	local myHRP = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not myHRP then return end

	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if player ~= LocalPlayer then
			local char = player.Character
			local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if hrp then
				hrp.CFrame = myHRP.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -2)
				setNoCollision(char, true)
			end
		end
	end
end)

-- ==============================
-- TEXTO RGB - FUNÇÕES
-- ==============================
local infoGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
infoGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
infoGui.Parent = LocalPlayer.PlayerGui

local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
text.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 100)
text.Position = UDim2.new(1, -230, 0, 20)
text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
text.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
text.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
text.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
text.TextSize = 16
text.Text = "FUNÇÕES\n\n• Head Hitbox\n• ESP\n• Aimbot"
text.Parent = infoGui

-- RGB ANIMAÇÃO
local hue = 0
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	hue = (hue + dt * 0.4) % 1
	text.TextColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 1, 1)
end)
